headline: Duke Energy Closes $875 Million Senior Notes Offering Maturing in 2036
summary: Duke Energy has finalized the issuance of $875 million in senior notes due 2036 to support general corporate operations and capital expenditures across its utility operations.
why: Duke Energy is one of the largest electric power holding companies in the US, requiring continuous debt market access to fund grid and generation investments.

impacts.name: Duke Energy Corporation
impacts.why: The $875M debt placement secures long-term fixed financing for capital projects.
